entry_thesis: Close the 10 million dollar-yen long and pay 25 million of March 2027 SOFR. Dollar-yen at 159.30 is only slightly ahead of the 159.23 entry and the five-day rise is 0.7 percent, so that momentum has stalled. The live trend is the higher US policy path: March implied is 4.545, up 61.5bp, with the two-year at 4.80 and the ten-year at 5.10.

invalidation: Cover the March pay if March implied stops rising together with the two-year and the ten-year, or if March gives back the day's 61.5bp reprice. A September print that keeps extending while March stalls would move the pay to September.
